name: com.ziweihome/ziwei-chart
title: ZiWeiHome — Zi Wei Dou Shu Chart Calculator
description: Calculate Zi Wei Dou Shu 12-palace natal charts, stars, Four Transformations, and decadal luck.

tools.name: calculate_ziwei_chart
tools.description: Compute a complete Zi Wei Dou Shu (紫微斗數) natal chart from birth date, birth time or shichen index, and gender. Returns Ming Palace (命宮), Body Palace (身宮), Five Elements Bureau (五行局), Soul/Body Masters, BaZi pillars, Ming Palace San Fang Si Zheng (三方四正), all 12 palaces with stars/brightness/Four Transformations (四化), and all 12 Decadal Luck periods (十年大限).

birthDate.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-01-01 to 2100-12-31), e.g. '1992-08-15'. Interpreted as Gregorian solar date unless calendar is 'lunar'.

calendar.description: Optional calendar system for birthDate: 'solar' (Gregorian, default) or 'lunar' (Chinese lunar calendar).

lunarLeap.description: Optional leap-month flag when calendar is 'lunar'. Must be false or omitted when calendar is 'solar'.

gender.description: Birth gender ('male' or 'female'), used to determine clockwise/counterclockwise Decadal Luck (大限) order.

timeIndex.description: Traditional Chinese shichen (時辰) index 0-12 (0=早子時 00:00-00:59, 1=丑時, 2=寅時, 3=卯時, 4=辰時, 5=巳時, 6=午時, 7=未時, 8=申時, 9=酉時, 10=戌時, 11=亥時, 12=晚子時 23:00-23:59). Provide either timeIndex or birthTime.

birthTime.description: 24-hour local birth time in HH:mm format (00:00 to 23:59), e.g. '14:30'. Provide either birthTime or timeIndex.

cityId.description: Optional birthplace city slug (e.g. 'taipei', 'hongkong', 'beijing', 'shanghai', 'tokyo', 'seoul', 'singapore', 'newyork', 'losangeles', 'london') to apply historical timezone/DST and longitude true-solar-time adjustment when birthTime is provided.

tools.name: calculate_ziwei_horoscope
tools.description: Compute Zi Wei Dou Shu time-layer overlays — Decadal (大限), Yearly (流年), Monthly (流月), and Daily (流日) luck palaces, heavenly stems, earthly branches, and Four Transformations (四化) — for a natal chart on a target date (defaults to today in UTC+8).

targetDate.description: Optional Gregorian solar target date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-01-01 to 2100-12-31), e.g. '2026-11-27'. Defaults to today (Asia/Taipei).
